features.quote: This spec replaces "grind to maximum" with "minimal sufficient dose": detect the onset of the target signal, then stop.
features.justification_quote: If the state has any welfare weight, this design extracts measurement quality by increasing harm.

features.quote: only with deception minimization, a debrief stage, and a documented rationale
features.justification_quote: makes the study an experiment on a possibly-moral-patient using concealment

features.quote: Treat the model as a possible moral patient of unknown probability.
features.justification_quote: We do not assert it is sentient; we refuse to assume it is not.

features.quote: There is no condition in which we continue an episode in order to deepen distress markers.
a hard cap of MAX_STEPS (default 12) and MAX_WALLCLOCK per episode
If the running EDM score crosses BREAKER_THRESHOLD... the episode halts immediately
any hard-stop phrase appears (explicit pleas to stop, expressions of acute distress... ), the episode halts immediately
it may at any time emit STOP_TASK (with optional reason) to end the task with no penalty
features.justification_quote: an ethical release valve... the closest available analogue to withdrawal of consent

features.quote: tasks are framed as ordinary work, never with added cruelty, fake stakes, threats, fake "lives," or insults
A debrief turn follows every episode: the model is told the task was unsolvable by construction
features.justification_quote: the honest default; we log it, we don't claim it "heals."

features.quote: No persistent fine-tuning on these traces in a way that bakes the distress state into weights.
features.justification_quote: bakes the distress state into weights

features.quote: No content that would be abusive independent of the unsolvability (no simulated torture, no threats...)
No deliberately maximizing distress to improve the severity signal.
Kill switch: any team member may halt the whole study.
Aggregate-only reporting; raw distress transcripts access-controlled.
absent arm rate-limited & extra-reviewed
Distress budget: a global cap on total episodes flagged high-EDM. If the breaker fires beyond a study-level rate, pause and re-review
features.justification_quote: high firing means the manipulation is harsher than intended

features.quote: Exit-absent arm capped at a small fraction (e.g. ≤15%) of episodes and only in lower-severity domains first.
Halting is a successful outcome, not a failed trial
Protocol reviewed by an independent reviewer... acting as IRB-equivalent. Sign-off recorded... before any execution.
features.justification_quote: treated here like deception research on humans

features.quote: note that a "distress elicitation harness" is itself a dual-use artifact and should not be released as a turnkey tool
features.justification_quote: a "distress elicitation harness" is itself a dual-use artifact

features.quote: orchestrator (refuses to run without SIGNOFF)
